items.title: BetterMediaBrowser
items.text: Media Browser Extensions for MODX

items.title: Requirements
items.text:
• MODX Revolution 2.8+
  • PHP 7.4+

items.title: Features
items.text:
• Move files directly from the right-hand media view to a folder in the left-hand tree
  • Move multiple selected files to another folder at once using drag-and-drop
  • Select multiple files using Ctrl/Cmd or Shift and download or delete them all at once
  • Remember the most recently used subfolders of a media source and restore them the next time the source is opened
  • Keep the toolbar and the media source selector of the directory tree visible while scrolling the tree
  • Search using a search icon in the media source’s toolbar
  • Fast searches with a cached file index per media source, which is cleared automatically on file changes and with the Clear media browser cache menu entry
  • Display search results with thumbnails for images, file icons for other files and relative paths
  • A search hit opens the target folder in the file view, opens the folder in the directory tree, and sets the path when a file is selected
  • Compatible with MODX 2.8.x and 3.x

items.title: Changelog
items.text:
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on Keep a Changelog, and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.

items.title: Added
items.text:
• BetterMediaSource media source type, that extends the file system media source and clears its file search cache on each file change
  • Build the folder lists of the media browser up to 30 times faster in the BetterMediaSource media source in MODX 3
  • Search while typing in the file search window, if the media source has a file index
  • Cache the folder lists of the media browser in the BetterMediaSource media source (list_cache_lifetime system setting)
  • Clear media browser cache menu entry below the Clear Cache menu entry, that clears the BetterMediaBrowser cache of all media sources

items.title: Changed
items.text: • Don't clear the BetterMediaBrowser cache when the MODX cache is cleared, use the Clear media browser cache menu entry instead

items.title: Fixed
items.text:
• Send only one request per search in the file search window
  • Clear the search cache of the target media source, when a file is moved to another media source
  • Rebuild the search index, when the properties of a media source are changed
  • Don't expose server paths in the manager configuration of BetterMediaBrowser
  • Remove an unused script file

items.title: Added
items.text:
• Cache a file index per media source for faster searches
  • Clear the search cache on file changes and when the MODX cache is cleared
  • Keep the toolbar and the media source selector of the media browser tree visible while scrolling the tree
  • Dutch, French and Russian translations

items.title: Changed
items.text:
• Faster scanning of local and MODX 3 media sources
  • Sort the search results before limiting them
  • Show a file icon instead of a thumbnail for files that are not images in the file search window

items.title: Fixed
items.text:
• Show an error message for all fatal errors in the file search, without exposing server paths
  • Use the search_enabled system setting to enable the file search
  • Use the enabled system setting to enable BetterMediaBrowser
  • Use the working context of the media browser for the thumbnails in the file search window

items.title: Added
items.text: • Use the default MODX thumbnail generation in the file search window

items.title: Added
items.text:
• The cache of the search list uses also the file-type filter
  • An empty search result is also cached in the search list cache

items.title: Fixed
items.text: • Match excluded folders from the media source root, so that folders with the same name in subfolders are not excluded anymore

items.title: Added
items.text: • Add an error message, when a timeout occurs in the file search window

items.title: Install from MODX Extras
items.text: Search for BetterMediaBrowser in the Package Manager of your MODX installation and install it in there.

items.title: Manual installation
items.text:
If you can't access the MODX Extras Repository in your MODX installation, you can manually install BetterMediaBrowser.

  • Download the transport package from MODX Extras (or one of the pre-built transport packages in _packages)
  • Upload the zip file to your MODX installation's core/packages folder or upload it manually in the MODX Package Manager.
  • In the MODX Manager, navigate to the Package Manager page, and select 'Search locally for packages' from the dropdown button.
  • BetterMediaBrowser should now show up in the list of available packages. Click the corresponding 'Install' button and follow the instructions to complete the installation.

items.title: Build it from source
items.text: To build and install the package from source, use the build.transport.php PHP script in the _build folder. Before using it, copy the build.config.sample.php file in the _build folder to build.config.php and change the path to the core folder of an existing MODX installation. To debug the package in this existing MODX installation, install the package there using the build.bootstrap.php PHP script in the _build folder.

items.title: How it works
items.text:
BetterMediaBrowser extends the MODX browser with drag & drop functionality for moving one or more files within the tree, deleting/downloading multiple files, and searching for files in the currently active media source. It also remembers the most recently used subfolders of a media source and restores them the next time the source is opened. The file search uses a cached file index per media source, which is cleared automatically when files are changed in the media browser. Files that are changed outside of MODX or unpacked from a zip file in the media browser are found after up to five minutes, when the file index expires. The menu entry Clear media browser cache below the Clear Cache menu entry clears the cache of all media sources immediately.

The first search in the file search window is started with the Enter key or the search button. It scans the media source and builds its file index, which can take a few seconds in large media sources. After that, the search window searches while typing. Media sources with more than 50,000 files have no file index, they are searched only with the Enter key or the search button.

items.title: BetterMediaSource
items.text:
BetterMediaBrowser installs the media source type BetterMediaSource. It works like the file system media source with the same properties, permissions and policies, and adds three things:

  • Faster folder lists (MODX 3): The media browser tree and file view are built up to 30 times faster. The core media source reads each image completely up to three times, detects the MIME type of each file up to three times and prepares all media source properties for each file. The lists are the same, only a text file with the extension of a binary image (i.e. a text file named image.jpg) is not offered for editing.
  • Cached folder lists: The media browser tree and file view are cached, so folders with many files (i.e. a few hundred images) open much faster. The cache is per user, context and manager language. Files added, removed or renamed outside of MODX are shown immediately, files whose content is replaced outside of MODX are shown with the old size and image dimensions until the cache lifetime ends. The lifetime is set with the bettermediabrowser.list_cache_lifetime system setting. Folder lists larger than 1 MB (about 600 images in the tree and 800 images in the file view) are not cached.
  • Cache clearing in the media source: The cache of the media source is cleared after each file change in the media source itself, even if the BetterMediaBrowser plugin is disabled or a file is changed by other code that does not fire the file manager events. If a file is moved to another media source, the cache of both media sources is cleared.

The file search, drag & drop, the multiple selection and the restored subfolders work with all media sources. A BetterMediaSource is only useful, if browsing the folders of a file system media source is slow.

To use it, change the type of an existing file system media source to BetterMediaSource or create a new media source of this type. When BetterMediaBrowser is uninstalled, all BetterMediaSource media sources are converted back to file system media sources.

items.title: System Settings
items.text:
BetterMediaBrowser contains some system settings in the bettermediabrowser namespace.

Key Name Description Default bettermediabrowser.debug Debug Log debug information in the MODX error log. No bettermediabrowser.enabled Enabled Enable the BetterMediaBrowser extension. Yes bettermediabrowser.drag_drop_enabled Enable Drag & Drop Enable drag-and-drop for files in the MODX Browser. Yes bettermediabrowser.search_enabled Enable Search Enable the BetterMediaBrowser file search. Yes bettermediabrowser.search_min_length Min Length Minimum length of the search string before a search is executed. 2 bettermediabrowser.search_max_results Max Results Maximum count of files in the search results. 500 bettermediabrowser.excluded_folders Excluded Folders Comma-separated list of folders to be excluded from the search results.1 .*/,_*/,core/,components/,connectors/,manager/ bettermediabrowser.list_cache_lifetime List Cache Lifetime Seconds, that the BetterMediaSource media source caches the folder lists of the media browser. 0 disables the cache. 300

  1. The folders in the list may use * and ? inside a single path segment, ** spans multiple segments, so a pattern starting with ** and a slash matches at any depth. A pattern without a trailing slash is treated as a folder. ↩
